Origin & botanical facts
The olive is one of the oldest known cul-
tivated fruits; cultivation of what had
been wild olive trees predates recorded
history and probably began on the Greek
peninsula of Attica.  In the early 18th
century, Spanish explorers brought olive
cuttings to Peru, from where they were
